_meta.description: The standard power configurations of Mutants & Masterminds — the named, pre-built powers the rulebook lists in its appendix (Blast, Dazzle, Force Field, Invisibility, …) and in each effect's own CONFIGURATIONS section. They are shorthand, not new rules: every one is an ordinary assembly of effects, extras and flaws that already exist in effects.json / modifiers.json / effect_modifiers.json, so dropping one on the constructor's canvas builds a power the player can then edit like any other. All 'description' fields are original short paraphrases written for this project, not rulebook prose; the builds and costs are game facts.
_meta.schema: Each entry is { id, name, baseEffect, costNote, cite, description, structure?, effects[] }. 'baseEffect' is the effect id the configuration is filed under in the palette. 'costNote' is the cost the book prints for it, and 'cite' the PDF page — both are reference text, never used in the arithmetic: what a built power costs is always derived by core.rules from the effects and modifiers below. 'structure' is only meaningful for a multi-effect configuration (independent | linked | array; omitted means independent). Each effects[] entry is { effectId, rank?, config?, extras?, flaws? }, where 'rank' is a fixed rank the configuration nails down (Invisibility is Concealment 2) and 0 or absent leaves the player to set it, 'config' seeds the effect's own configurable qualities, and 'extras'/'flaws' are { id, rank?, config? } modifier selections.
_meta.costNote: 'costNote' always reports what the book prints, and a built power is priced independently from its parts — so the two agreeing is a real check on the recorded build. Two of the ninety do not agree, and the reason is known. MATERIAL MIMICRY and POWER MIMICRY (book 5, built 6): the book puts the Close Range flaw on Variable, which is a Personal-range effect, where that flaw has no defined value - it is priced only from Ranged and from Perception. Each is built as the book literally names it rather than gaining an invented modifier to force the printed number.
_meta.provenance: Open Game Content derived from the Mutants & Masterminds SRD; see LICENSE-CONTENT.md and docs/open_game_license.md. No Product Identity.

configurations.name: Absorption
configurations.description: You are not only immune to a Damage descriptor — attacks of it make you stronger, feeding a Trait Boost.

configurations.name: Affliction Aura
configurations.description: Anyone who touches you, or whom you touch, is subject to your Affliction.

configurations.name: Ageless
configurations.description: You do not age and cannot be aged. You can still die of other causes, and cannot come back from Dead without Regeneration.

configurations.name: Animal Harmony
configurations.description: Natural animals start Favorable towards you; predators do not read you as prey, prey animals do not read you as a threat.

features.name: Animal Harmony
features.description: Natural animals start Favorable towards you; predators do not read you as prey, prey animals do not read you as a threat.

configurations.name: Animal Mimicry
configurations.description: Mimic the traits of animals, allocating your Variable points to them. Often narrowed further to one class of animal.

configurations.name: Armored Skin
configurations.costNote: 1 point for 2 ranks, then 1 per rank
configurations.description: Ordinary Protection, but noticeably so — armoured scales, metallic skin, or the like.

configurations.name: Astral Projection
configurations.description: Send your astral body — your mind or spirit — out to observe, leaving your physical body defenceless and immobile behind you.

config.detail: Your physical body is defenceless and immobile

configurations.name: Battery
configurations.description: Power or recharge small electrical devices by touch, as if you were an outlet.

features.name: Battery
features.description: Power or recharge small electrical devices by touch, as if you were an outlet.

configurations.name: Berserker Rage
configurations.description: You fly into a rage as a free action, gaining Strength and immunity to fear at the cost of some of your willingness to defend yourself.

configurations.name: Blast
configurations.description: Damage at a distance, using a ranged attack check against Defense.

configurations.name: Built-in Equipment
configurations.description: A built-in or implanted equivalent of a 1-point piece of equipment — a phone, a calculator, a stopwatch.

features.name: Built-in Equipment
features.description: A built-in or implanted equivalent of a 1-point piece of equipment — a phone, a calculator, a stopwatch.

configurations.name: Charmed Life
configurations.description: Routine bad luck passes you by; the GM may not trouble you with minor-misfortune complications, and you get no Hero Points from them either.

features.name: Charmed Life
features.description: Routine bad luck passes you by; the GM may not trouble you with minor-misfortune complications, and you get no Hero Points from them either.

configurations.name: Chill
configurations.description: Generate a small, immediate drop in temperature — enough to raise gooseflesh and fog breath for a round.

features.name: Chill
features.description: Generate a small, immediate drop in temperature — enough to raise gooseflesh and fog breath for a round.

configurations.name: Commlink
configurations.description: A concealable radio earpiece for team chatter, usually over short ranges.

configurations.name: Cyclone
configurations.description: A wave of force in a cone extending out from you, pushing things away or dragging them towards you with a Trip action.

configurations.name: Damage Aura
configurations.description: A field around your body that damages anyone touching you — acid, electricity, fire, spikes.

configurations.name: Darkness
configurations.description: A sphere of complete darkness, fully concealing sight within it. Mist, smoke and dust work the same way.

configurations.name: Dazzle
configurations.description: Overwhelms one of the target's senses, chosen when the effect is configured. At three degrees the target only gets a check to shake it off once a minute.

configurations.name: Dimensional Pocket
configurations.description: An extra-dimensional space holding up to mass rank −1, +1 mass rank per further rank. Creatures cannot be put in it.

features.name: Dimensional Pocket
features.description: An extra-dimensional space holding up to mass rank −1, +1 mass rank per further rank. Creatures cannot be put in it.

configurations.name: Display
configurations.description: A harmless but showy display — flashing lights, minor obvious illusions — good for showing off and the odd Performance bonus.

features.name: Display
features.description: A harmless but showy display — flashing lights, minor obvious illusions — good for showing off and the odd Performance bonus.

configurations.name: Duplication
configurations.description: Summon an exact duplicate of yourself, with any traits you have up to your own ranks but without this power. Heroic and Multiple Minions are common.

configurations.name: [Effect] Resistance
configurations.description: Resistance to a particular effect rather than immunity: you halve its rank before resisting. Halves the cost of Environmental, Fortitude and Will Immunity.

configurations.name: Energy Tendrils
configurations.description: Tendrils or constructs of energy reaching out to grab and manipulate objects — a visible descriptor for a plain Move Object.

configurations.name: Environmental Immunity
configurations.description: Immune to every environmental hazard, as if you always wore a protective suit. Also called Life Support.

configurations.name: Flashlight
configurations.description: A basic light source throwing a cone-shaped area of illumination.

configurations.name: Force Constructs
configurations.description: Objects formed out of solidified energy. Selective and Variable Opacity are common; Subtle 2 suits constructs of invisible force.

configurations.name: Force Field
configurations.description: A protective field you switch on and off at will as a free action. Noticeable by default unless you add Subtle.

configurations.name: Fortitude Immunity
configurations.description: Immune to everything calling for a Fortitude check, environmental hazards included. Common for characters who are not living beings.

configurations.name: Gadgets
configurations.description: (rank × 5) Variable points of devices — technological or magical — that you reconfigure between scenes rather than in action time.

configurations.name: Gravity Field
configurations.description: A field pulling down across an area, grabbing and holding everyone in it. Add Damaging and it can crush them under the weight.

configurations.name: Hallucination
configurations.description: Influences what the target perceives, from a passing figment to a full delusion. Usually a mental projection; a biochemical version is Close or Ranged and resisted by Fortitude instead.

configurations.name: Higher Guidance
configurations.description: Occasional visions or messages from a higher power. An Enhanced Advantage version of Guidance, and it counts against your heroic-advantage limit.

features.name: Higher Guidance
features.description: Occasional visions or messages from a higher power. An Enhanced Advantage version of Guidance, and it counts against your heroic-advantage limit.

configurations.name: Inaudibility
configurations.description: You emit no sound and are fully concealed from normal hearing. A second rank hides you from every hearing sense, sonar and ultra-hearing included.

configurations.name: Insulating Fur
configurations.description: A layer of fur giving you Resistance to intense heat and cold.

features.name: Insulating Fur
features.description: A layer of fur giving you Resistance to intense heat and cold.

configurations.name: Interface
configurations.description: Talk to electronic devices in range, usually to extend Comprehend: Computers across a whole network.

configurations.name: Internal Compartment
configurations.description: A pouch or compartment inside your body, holding objects of size rank −3 relative to you and up to your Strength rank −2 in mass.

features.name: Internal Compartment
features.description: A pouch or compartment inside your body, holding objects of size rank −3 relative to you and up to your Strength rank −2 in mass.

configurations.name: Invisibility
configurations.description: Invisible to normal sight at will. Often extended to rank 4 (8 points) to cover every sight sense; the Blending flaw suits a “chameleon cloak”.

configurations.name: Iron Stomach
configurations.description: Eat anything non-toxic without ill effect, however unpleasant.

features.name: Iron Stomach
features.description: Eat anything non-toxic without ill effect, however unpleasant.

configurations.name: Light Sleeper
configurations.description: One degree of success on a Perception check wakes you from Asleep, rather than three.

features.name: Light Sleeper
features.description: One degree of success on a Perception check wakes you from Asleep, rather than three.

configurations.name: Lucid Dreamer
configurations.description: Control what you dream and stay aware that you are dreaming. Each rank also grants one use of Edit Scene, while dreaming.

features.name: Lucid Dreamer
features.description: Control what you dream and stay aware that you are dreaming. Each rank also grants one use of Edit Scene, while dreaming.

configurations.name: Massive
configurations.description: +1 mass rank per rank with no change to Strength or carrying capacity, and +1 per rank to resist being moved against your will.

features.name: Massive
features.description: +1 mass rank per rank with no change to Strength or carrying capacity, and +1 per rank to resist being moved against your will.

configurations.name: Material Mimicry
configurations.description: Mimic the properties of substances you touch — usually Protection at the material's Toughness, often Hardened or Impervious, plus Strength or Insubstantial.

configurations.name: Matter Shaping
configurations.description: Shapes a material — earth, ice, metal, stone, wood — into new forms that stay put once made.

configurations.name: [Matter] Moving
configurations.description: Control one type of material — metal, plant, rock, water. Name it in place of [Matter], or use the fancier “-kinesis” suffix.

configurations.name: Megaphone
configurations.description: Amplify your voice like a living megaphone, negating up to a −20 distance penalty to be heard.

features.name: Megaphone
features.description: Amplify your voice like a living megaphone, negating up to a −20 distance penalty to be heard.

configurations.name: Mental Blast
configurations.description: Damage with no attack check, affecting anyone you can accurately perceive and resisted by Will — so it cannot hurt anyone immune to Will effects.

configurations.name: Mental Immunity
configurations.description: Immune to mental powers acting directly on your mind — a narrower thing than Will Immunity, which covers every Will-resisted effect.

configurations.name: Mimicry
configurations.description: Imitate almost any sound you have heard, with a +10 bonus to Deception checks to sell it as real.

features.name: Mimicry
features.description: Imitate almost any sound you have heard, with a +10 bonus to Deception checks to sell it as real.

configurations.name: Mind Control
configurations.description: Controls a target's mind and actions. You issue a command as part of using it, and changing the command later takes a Command action. Not a particularly heroic power — the GM may bar it for player characters.

configurations.name: Mist
configurations.description: An area around you fills with light, obscuring mist. Take the −5 visibility condition instead for a thicker fog; for sight blocked outright, see Obscure.

configurations.name: Paralyze
configurations.description: Slows a target and can stop them moving at all — a numbing field, nerve strikes, or paralysing venom. Add Ranged for a paralysing ray or mist.

configurations.name: Poltergeist
configurations.description: An unseen helper moving things around you, easily mistaken for accidents, bad luck or a haunting. Add Triggered (+3 per rank) and it acts on its own.

config.condition: Only for targeting the Move Object

configurations.name: Portal
configurations.description: Open a gateway between two points as a free action instead of teleporting yourself. Anyone stepping through is teleported to its far end.

configurations.name: Power Mimicry
configurations.description: Mimic others' powers by touching them, matching their ranks up to their total or your Power Level limit, whichever is lower. An unwilling subject needs a close attack.

configurations.name: Power Theft
configurations.costNote: 6 points per rank, plus 2 per rank Linked
configurations.description: Touch a target and, if they fail to resist your Nullify, copy the powers they lost — then lose them yourself at a rank a round.

config.condition: Only powers lost by the target

configurations.name: Psychic Connection
configurations.description: A psychic link with one other person — a loved one, a twin. Sometimes One-Way, so the other person needs their own link to answer.

config.condition: That person only, no one else ever

configurations.name: Psychokinesis
configurations.description: Move objects with your mind, needing only to perceive the subject accurately. Ranks of Subtle are common when nothing shows but the result.

configurations.name: Quick Change
configurations.description: Change into or out of one particular outfit instantly as a free action. With 2 ranks, into any outfit at will.

features.name: Quick Change
features.description: Change into or out of one particular outfit instantly as a free action. With 2 ranks, into any outfit at will.

configurations.name: Radar
configurations.description: Perceive your surroundings accurately by bouncing radio waves off solid objects.

configurations.name: Remote
configurations.description: Act as a universal remote for machines and equipment that accept one.

features.name: Remote
features.description: Act as a universal remote for machines and equipment that accept one.

configurations.name: Scrying
configurations.description: Cast your senses out to perceive at a distance. Sometimes relies on a Removable focus — a crystal ball, a mirror — or on a Medium.

configurations.name: Shade
configurations.description: Inherent protection from intense light: you never sunburn or squint at glare. No protection from light-based effects.

features.name: Shade
features.description: Inherent protection from intense light: you never sunburn or squint at glare. No protection from light-based effects.

configurations.name: Shapeshift
configurations.description: Assume different forms, allocating your Variable points to their traits. The Action extra is common for shapeshifters who change quickly.

configurations.name: Silence
configurations.description: A sphere where no sound can be heard, nor enter or leave — good for stealth and for blocking anything that needs speech.

configurations.name: Skill Mimicry
configurations.description: Mimic the skills and advantages of anyone you can accurately perceive, up to their ranks or your Power Level limit. The Action extra is common.

configurations.name: Snare
configurations.description: Restrains a target in bonds of energy, ice, webbing or rope. Escaping is Sleight of Hand or Damage against the effect DC. Often Cumulative, so snares can be layered.

configurations.name: Sonar
configurations.description: Perceive your surroundings accurately by echolocation.

configurations.name: Spatial Sense
configurations.description: Feel your surroundings at a distance as if you could touch them, without actually doing so.

configurations.name: Special Effect
configurations.description: A signature flourish — a gust of wind, ideal spotlighting, personal theme music — worth a bonus when it would impress.

features.name: Special Effect
features.description: A signature flourish — a gust of wind, ideal spotlighting, personal theme music — worth a bonus when it would impress.

configurations.name: Static
configurations.description: A sphere that blocks radio signals inside it or crossing it. The mental version is “psychic static”.

configurations.name: Strike
configurations.description: Damage added to your Strength — enhanced punches, claws, horns, teeth, or a damaging field around your unarmed strikes. Often Linked to an Affliction.

configurations.name: Stun
configurations.description: Temporarily stuns a target — non-lethal energy, a weapon, or a targeted strike. Often Cumulative or Ranged; a “Sleep” version swaps Asleep for Incapacitated.

configurations.name: Suffocation
configurations.description: Renders a target unable to breathe. Concentrate each turn and they check again at the start of your turn with no further attack roll.

configurations.name: Telepathic Link
configurations.description: Mind-to-mind contact with willing characters in range. Often paired with Comprehend Languages 3 to get past language barriers.

configurations.name: Telepresence
configurations.description: See and hear through cameras, screens, microphones and other technology within range.

configurations.name: Temporal Inertia
configurations.description: You are anchored in the space-time continuum and immune to changes in history, recalling the true version of events when they change.

features.name: Temporal Inertia
features.description: You are anchored in the space-time continuum and immune to changes in history, recalling the true version of events when they change.

configurations.name: Tether
configurations.description: Grab, pull and swing objects on a line — rope, cable, or a projection of energy. The tether has Toughness equal to its rank and drops what it holds if it breaks.

configurations.name: Toxin
configurations.description: A debilitating toxin or drug. Often Progressive or Prolonged and sometimes with Onset; injected toxins add Resistible for a Toughness check first.

configurations.name: Trait Boost
configurations.costNote: the trait's cost −1 point per rank
configurations.description: An Enhanced Trait activated as a free action that then loses a rank of effect every round until it is gone. Common as an “absorption” power, where resisting an effect feeds the boost.

configurations.name: Transform
configurations.description: Transforms the target into another form, chosen when the power is configured. The first two degrees only add to the total; the change lands at three. Often Ranged, and may take Empowering or Variable Conditions.

configurations.name: True Sight
configurations.description: See through every form of concealment and every illusion.

configurations.name: Wards
configurations.description: A magical or psychic ward blocking Detect and Remote Sensing effects of a similar descriptor, so nobody can spy or eavesdrop through them.

configurations.name: Water Breathing
configurations.description: Breathe normally under water and never drown. Often taken with Environmental Adaptation: Aquatic and ranks of Swimming.

configurations.name: Weaken
configurations.description: Saps one of the target's traits, chosen when the effect is configured. Without the Limited flaw it hits every trait; with Affects Objects it can weaken gear.

configurations.name: Weapon
configurations.costNote: 1 point per rank, −1 point per 5 points
configurations.description: A hand-held weapon — knuckles, knife, sword, hammer, staff. Throwing weapons add Thrown; ranged ones add Ranged, like Blast.

configurations.name: Weather Control
configurations.description: Control the weather in an area, mixing cold, heat, hindered and hazardous movement and visibility in whatever amounts the conditions call for, up to 4 points per rank.

configurations.name: Weatherproof
configurations.description: Whatever the weather, you stay dry and unmussed. No resistance to weather hazards.

features.name: Weatherproof
features.description: Whatever the weather, you stay dry and unmussed. No resistance to weather hazards.

configurations.name: Will Immunity
configurations.description: Immune to everything calling for a Will check. Common for characters who lack minds or have especially impenetrable ones.

configurations.name: Wings
configurations.description: Wings — bird-like, bat-like, or bug-like — that let you fly, but only while you are free to flap them.

configurations.name: X-Ray Vision
configurations.description: See through opaque objects as if they were transparent.
